digest.component_or_area: rebar init store bootstrap / branch mount
propositions: When the fetch of origin/tickets times out and the remote-tracking ref never materializes, init silently orphan-bootstraps a fresh empty store instead of failing.
The empty divergent store makes rebar list return [] and causes new writes to land on a branch that cannot fast-forward onto origin/tickets.
init must probe the configured remote with a bounded ls-remote and refuse (non-zero exit) when the remote advertises the tickets branch, never orphan-bootstrapping.
When the remote is reachable but does not advertise the tickets branch, init must still bootstrap as the legitimate first-init case.
When the remote is unreachable or the probe times out, init must fail closed with a distinct message, unless an explicit opt-in flag is passed to force a fresh store.
pending_init_attaches_to_existing shares the same false-negative failure and both call sites must resolve remote existence through one shared helper.
